Help


Broadband Source Override: This field indicates the type of WAN interface in use.
  • Auto will cause the system to attempt to figure out by trial and error what type of line is connected.
  • Ethernet will tell the system that a WAN Ethernet interface is in use.
  • Fiber will tell the system that a Fiberoptic interface is in use.
Base MTU: The MTU (Maximum Transmittable Unit) indicates the maximum packet size before the device will split a packet into multiple packets. The MTU range is 1280 - 1500 with IPv6 enabled.

IPv6 MTU: Any IPv6 packet larger than the IPv6 MTU will be rejected and the originator will receive a 'Packet Too Big' message. In native IPv6, the Base MTU and IPv6 MTU are configured independently. When using 6rd, the IPv6 MTU is not configurable.
